SOURCE_BINDING.ordered_product_rule: For the S_r extension the edge label is an ordered product X*Y_1*...*Y_{r-1}; for r=4 the new factors are tau14, tau24, tau34 with transposition probabilities 1/4, 1/3, 1/2 respectively.

SEQUENTIAL_TAU14_TAU24_COMMON_MIDDLE.important_nuance: A common residual suffix S after tau24 exists, but it is not sufficient to produce branch-independent L_+/L_- interface vectors for both sequential decisions.

tau24_conditional_on_tau14.hermitian_rank_two_difference: -2[(h tensor B eta)(t tensor S^*eta)^* + h.c.]
tau24_conditional_on_tau14.branch_conditioned_pair: x_B=h tensor B eta, y=t tensor S^*eta; d_{1|B}=x_B-y, d_{0|B}=x_B+y
tau24_conditional_on_tau14.consequence: The actual tau24 rank-one interface depends on the already fixed tau14 branch. There is no single branch-independent d_1=L_-(eta), d_0=L_+(eta) valid for both B branches.

tau14_conditional_on_tau24.branch_conditioned_pair: x=h tensor delta, y_C=t tensor S^* C^*delta; c_{1|C}=x-y_C, c_{0|C}=x+y_C
tau14_conditional_on_tau24.consequence: The actual tau14 rank-one interface inside the four-joint-branch analysis depends on the tau24 branch. There is no single fixed c_1=L_-(delta), c_0=L_+(delta) valid simultaneously for both C branches.

SEQUENTIAL_TAU14_TAU24_COMMON_MIDDLE.not_claimed: No theorem that no other joint weighted compression exists; only the frozen fixed-vector diamond premise is falsified.

reason: For tau24 after tau14=transposition, the left root is R_delta eta=-alpha rather than eta.
For tau14 evaluated jointly with tau24=transposition, the right transported root is R_eta delta=alpha rather than delta.
Therefore the four joint branches cannot all be represented by one common branch-independent pair of maps L_-(x),L_+(x) using fixed roots delta and eta.

DIAGONAL_ANNIHILATION.reason: The preregistered diagonal wedge formulas use fixed c0,c1,d0,d1. Those fixed lifted vectors are not the actual four-branch sequential HPS interfaces, so the proposed diagonal-zero proof would not certify the true conditioned determinant geometry.
